jobs.prompt: Create ONE BrineSpace furniture assembly: a compact two-person loveseat with two broad seat cushions and ONE small square wooden side table beside its outer arm. Reference provides hand-painted industrial material style and elevated overhead/cutaway camera. Rotate the furniture in the floor plane so the seat's FRONT OPEN EDGE faces SOUTHEAST, toward the lower-right of the image; backrest lies toward upper-left. This directional orientation is essential. Preserve the elevated game camera: clearly visible seat cushion tops and table top, shallow readable front apron and supports. Do not lower camera to a showroom perspective. Substantial charcoal metal/wood frame, muted gray-taupe matte fabric, no blanket, one small subdued olive pillow at one end. Side table has short stout charcoal legs and warm desaturated wooden top with one small plain gray mug. Table sits beside seat within easy reach, not in front blocking access; real transparent gap between separate furniture pieces. Adult-sized seats, side table noticeably smaller and at armrest height or below. Match reference painted texture but restrain fabric grain and edge highlights at export 365x260 pixels. No glossy finish, bright white piping, dense scratches, photorealism, text, people, floor, walls, exterior cast shadows or glow. Full silhouettes with margins, true transparent background and gaps.
